findings.text: follow-on: the overview paragraph states 'the nine .bf field-list includes and #INTERFACE.inc' while the detail paragraph beneath (the admitted-includes block) states 'the facility holds 10 CodeFiles ending .bf' and enumerates ten (#CNT, #EQ2M, #EQTTL, #EQU, #EQV, #GEO, #MSEDB, #OUT, #PAR, #VAC). The node's own census confirms ten (incF_final.json bf_count = 10). The overview undercounts by one and contradicts the detail in the same fragment; it is a text defect in the deliverable, not a data defect.

follow-on: plan §35 step (4) says to re-open the inc/F path 'through the existing reset owner, scoped by prefix', but the fragment records that the reset owner alone is insufficient -- the path had also scored 0.4, below the 0.9 discovery threshold, so '--min-score' had to be lowered. The fragment flags this as 'an addition beyond the literal step-(4) form'. The literal plan text therefore cannot list the includes; the plan wording, not the node, is the thing to correct.

justifications.evidence: The fragment's numbers reconcile with the node's recorded census and search outputs (census_final2.json total 3219, admitted 265, below-gates 334; search 10 matches, top hit 6.12); the §14 criterion is honestly reported as only partially met; marked down because the gate is a scripted census with no arm-pair and the inc/F per-file scores live only in the manifest, not the fragment.
justifications.fit: The fragment follows the evidence-fragment idiom used by its siblings (section/h2/paragraph ids, a census table) and introduces no forbidden name; 'noul' is the plan's own term.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All six done-when clauses are reported in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/five-scope-rejudge.html (overview, census table, admitted list, inc/F includes, simulation list, §14 search, spend); marked down only because the overview undercounts the .bf set as 'nine' and the includes are not each given a score in the fragment.
justifications.reuse: The node reused the existing discover-code CLI and the graph census/search path rather than adding a parallel mechanism; no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: The entire diff is one file inside the declared write paths (docs/evidence/fragments.../five-scope-rejudge.html), +142 lines, no path outside the set and no repository code touched.
